title.zh: Binance's Tokenized Equities Product bStocks Surpasses $1B in AUM with $40B in C
title.en: Binance's Tokenized Equities Product bStocks Surpasses $1B in AUM with $40B in C

current_state.zh: Binance announced that its tokenized equities product bStocks has surpassed $1 billion in AUM about four months after launch, with over $40 billion in cumulative trading volume, $300 million-plus daily volume across roughly 100 assets, and more than $6 billion in 1:1 conversions between underlying equities and tokens.
